history.text: The Aksumite kingdom traded through the Red Sea port of Adulis.
Italy proclaimed the colony of Eritrea.
The territory was federated with Ethiopia by UN resolution.
A thirty-year armed struggle for independence was fought.
Independence was confirmed by referendum on 24 May.
A border war with Ethiopia caused heavy casualties.
